 The best Korean sheet masks for dewy, photogenic skin in minutes
 WORDS Emily Algar      PUBLISHED Mon, 2 Nov 2026 - 1:25 pm 
 Skincare is, for the most part, a long haul game. But sometimes, I can't resist the allure of a quick win. Sheet masks are leaders in this very category, and no one does a sheet masks quite like a Korean beauty brand .
 Sheet masks have long been a popular product format in the realm of K-beauty. Most involve a serum or essence-soaked piece of fabric or gel that's layered onto the skin, pushing ingredients in to soothe, hydrate, plump and tighten. As for K-beauty, there's no shortage of options, but some are more popular than others (you might have seen Hailey Bieber , who just returned from Seoul, wearing the viral Pyderin blue sheet mask – good luck to the rest of us getting our hands on one now). Mind you, we've for the Pyderin link and many other Korean sheet mask suggestions for your plumpest, dewiest complexion below.
 Biodance Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask 
 You know this one. It's Internet viral, but I really do think it works, pending you nail the application process. I find this is best with a milky essence or serum layered underneath. And be sure to wear it for a good few hours – it will turn transparent, and you'll have the skin of a newborn (or close to it) when you peel it off.
 Best for: Pre-event skin.
 Dr Jart+ Cryo Rubber Firming Mask 
 Dr Jart+ is a leader in the K-beauty masking arena and I get why. It comes with a serum ampoule (this one is full of tightening peptides) you slather on before locking in with the rubbery mask. It cools the skin, leaving it poreless and lifted in twenty-ish minutes. Put it in the fridge for even more of a cooling sensation.
 Best for: Lifting, filling and tightening, or an instant 'Botox' effect.
 Skin 1004 Madagascar Centella Watergel Sheet Ampuole Mask 
 This drenches the skin in soothing moisture, almost like a hospital bandage. It's full of centella, a plant extract known to calm irritated skin. Perfect if you've been flying, overdone the actives or had a particularly spicy procedure.
 Best for: Red, tight, irritated skin or instant recovery.
 Pyderin Federin Hydro Booster PDRN SOS Hyal Soothing Mask 
 This mask is Hailey's choice, so you know it's special. It's soaked in pure PDRN , snail mucin, hyaluronic acid and sodium PGA, so it works to pull water into the skin while soothing for a plump, dewy finish. According to the Internet, it's often sold out.
 Best for: Dewy hydration.
 Mediheal Collagen Essential Mask 
 This mask is bamboo-derived, and loaded with peptides, low molecular vegan collagen, glycerin and plant oils, so it's great for nourishing dry, depleted skin. You'll get a temporary plump thanks to all the moisture, as well.
 Best for: Dry, dull skin.
 Torriden Dive In Low Molecule Hyaluronic Acid Mask 
 This mask is pure moisture. The hero is low molecular hyaluronic acid, that pulls water into the skin, leaving it bouncy, dewy and comfortable. It's fragrance free, fits snugly, and works for all skin types.
 Best for: Super tight, dehydrated skin.
 Mediheal Spicule Pore Tightening System 2 
 I bought this mask when I was in Seoul over Christmas, intrigued by the 'pore tightening' concept. Turns out, it works pretty well. You initially massage in a serum before you layer the mask on top and it kind of tingles. The collagen 'spicules' are allegedly so tiny they are easily absorbed, and it works to tighten the look of pores for a smooth, glassy effect.
 Best for: Large pores, unrefined skin texture.
 Rejuran c-PDRN Booster Shot Gel Mask 
 This mask is all about firmness and glow. You can wear it for an hour, or go hard and sleep in it. There's collagen boosters, PDRN (read up on that here ) plus hydrators to diffuse the look of lines and wrinkles while plumping tired skin.
 Best for: Signs of ageing.
 Abib Mild Acidic pH Sheet Mask 
 Interestingly, this mask is made from bamboo and egg whites, soaked in a lightweight but supremely nourishing mix of soothing plant extracts. It's softening, calming and good for sensitive skin. It also kind of shrinks as you wear it, wrapping to the face for maximum absorption.
 Best for: Dry, sensitive skin.
